labels.ambiguous: Relevant context exists but supports competing reasonable semantic readings; not a replacement for clear mismatch or missing text.
labels.contextual_topic_match: A meaningful causal, policy or explanatory connection to the concept; not merely a passing name.
labels.direct_topic_match: Substantive explicit discussion of the expected concept; prospective or historical topic discussion counts when substantive.
labels.document_unavailable: No successful bounded public article retrieval, including HTTP/network/unsupported-response failure.
labels.incidental_or_weak_match: Genuine concept mentioned only in passing, background or an unrelated list.
labels.insufficient_context: Accessible response cannot establish article identity or adequate semantic context, including blocked pages, homepage/replacement redirects and uncertain extraction.
labels.semantic_mismatch: Sufficient context establishes a different subject or lexical/metaphorical collision, without substantive expected concept. Do not conceal clear mismatch as ambiguous.

review.adjudication: No automatic majority adjudication; gate must pass for both independent human reviewers. Disagreement remains visible.
review.blinding: none; year/source shown, no prevalence or expected conclusion in packet
review.human_requirements: Two independently registered genuine human reviewers; registry must be supplied by trusted operator, not inferred from submitted annotations. No manufactured human reviews.
review.llm_role: not used; optional future secondary assistance requires separate explicit reviewer registration
review.machine_role: retrieval and context preparation only, never topical ground truth
